title: ECC HMAC-DRBG interface zeroize leaves SCA entropy seed registers live
claim: When ECC zeroize is asserted, the HMAC-DRBG interface clears several output registers but leaves the internal lfsr_seed_reg and sca_entropy_reg values unchanged. Those retained values feed the entropy path used by subsequent LFSR, lambda, scalar-randomization, and masking-randomization states.

source_locations.excerpt: The LFSR, lambda, scalar-randomization, and masking-randomization states use sca_entropy_reg as hmac_drbg_entropy.
The zeroize branch clears lambda_reg, scalar_rnd_reg, masking_rnd_reg, and drbg_reg, but not lfsr_seed_reg.
counter_nonce_reg and sca_entropy_reg are reset and loaded on en while idle, but have no zeroize branch.
sca_entropy is computed from IV, lfsr_seed_reg, and counter_nonce.

security_invariant: ECC zeroize must erase internal entropy and masking-seed residue before any later ECC HMAC-DRBG operation can reuse it.

attacker_model.capability: Can observe side-channel effects around ECC operations and can cause or wait for a zeroize followed by a later ECC HMAC-DRBG operation.
preconditions: The ECC HMAC-DRBG interface has completed enough work for lfsr_seed_reg and sca_entropy_reg to hold nonzero SCA entropy-derived values.
The zeroize input is asserted before the next operation.

proof_style: residue_effect_test with directed single-DUT Verilator simulation
proof_boundary: Compile the real ecc_hmac_drbg_interface module with deterministic child models that only provide handshake and nonzero DRBG values. The target property is the interface-local zeroize behavior, not cryptographic HMAC correctness.
controls: After reset, lfsr_seed_reg and sca_entropy_reg are zero.
After zeroize, lambda, scalar_rnd, masking_rnd, and drbg clear to zero.
witness: After a reachable signing-mode sequence makes all observed registers nonzero, zeroize leaves lfsr_seed_reg and sca_entropy_reg nonzero.
After zeroize, a restart observes hmac_drbg_entropy sourced from the retained sca_entropy_reg value.
expected_evidence: proof/logs/compile.log records a single-DUT Verilator build of ecc_hmac_drbg_interface with deterministic child models.
proof/logs/run.log records N003_CONTROL_RESET, N003_SETUP_NONZERO, N003_WITNESS_AFTER_ZEROIZE, N003_RESTART_INPUT_RESIDUE, and N003_ZEROIZE_RESIDUE_WITNESS_PASS.
